title: Covariance matrices in messages
keywords: covariance variance uncertainty matrix 6x6 3x3 row-major diagonal standard deviation ekf robot_localization fusion
text: PoseWithCovariance and TwistWithCovariance carry a 6x6 covariance as 36 numbers in row-major order for (x, y, z, rotation about X, rotation about Y, rotation about Z). Diagonal entries are variances, the standard deviation squared (m^2, rad^2). Filters treat a zero variance in a pose or twist as near-perfect certainty, so give an axis a sensor cannot measure a large variance, not zero. Sensor messages such as Imu use 3x3 matrices with their own convention: all zeros means unknown, and -1 in the first element means the value is not provided.
